summary: Round 3 (r3b1). Diagnosis: with 0.5 units/s of time penalty and free death, dying in the CP2 pit beats the detour+tunnel dive by 0.5 units, so every warm line relocked into the pit. Fix: --fail-pen 10 = time_pen/(1-gamma), i.e. death = never finishing (the objective becomes discounted progress); needs --surf-bonus 0 (the bonus becomes a farm in that frame) and T 0 (--unstuck-max 0; noise at T 2 made precise routes look bad). Incumbent ckpt + those flags: the greedy line leaves the pit within ~150M steps and flies the tunnel dive to its limit (28.851 at 7,504M, 6/9 past the window), training ceiling 29,027 -> 29,395 u (30.07%). With the surf bonus kept, the greedy line ENTERED the cavity (the human's route) 9/9 but parked (farm). Missing: the climb-out from the cavity (vz off the ramp too low).
